outcome: congenital anomalies of the central nervous system
cohort: This study included 120 women ranging from 18-45 years who were recruited from Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center and Tanveer Ultrasound Clinic.
finding: The study observed a significant association between maternal age, education level, family income, and medications with congenital malformations in fetuses, and found that most central nervous system anomalies were seen in the Urdu-speaking ethnic group.
